responsibility: Provides rustc-specific type visiting helpers built on `TypeVisitor`, including free-region iteration, late-bound region collection, and universe scanning across types, binders, and consts.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/visit.rs` and `thir/visit.rs`, which traverse MIR and THIR syntax trees respectively, this file works at the `ty` layer: it builds on the generic `TypeVisitor` machinery to inspect free regions, late-bound regions, and placeholder universes across types and consts.
